name: facets
label: Facets
description: Search facets response received from the search composite data resource. Currently, only a subset of fields from the response are used. An example can be found on the developer site

name: label
label: Label
description: Label that appears on the top of the component

name: selectedOptions
label: Selected options
description: Specifies which options should be selected, whether they are applicable to the tab, and type of facet

name: searchContextConfigId
label: Search context config
description: Search context configuration from the sys_search_context_config table

name: sortFilters
label: Sort filters
description: Specifies the items for sort filters. [{sysId: '123abc', label: 'Relevancy'}]

name: selectedSortFilters
label: Selected sort filter
description: Specifies the ID of selected sort filter. Eg: ['relevancy']

name: size
label: Size
description: Specifies if the mobile version or desktop version should be rendered

name: enableLabelTranslation
label: Enable label translate
description: Specifies if component should attempt to translate facet labels from sys_ui_message table

name: isLoading
label: Activate loading state for component
description: Activates loading state for component when search results are being fetched
